digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push delivery across async, library, and MCP surfaces
propositions: Failed git pre-receive rejections on async/library/MCP paths produce no warning delivery because stderr is discarded (DEVNULL), no logging handler is installed, or server stderr is unreachable to the agent
push.py spawns a detached Popen with start_new_session=True and DEVNULL stderr, never waited, so child warnings are OS-discarded while only OSError at spawn time is logged
Library code paths never install stderr handler outside the CLI/MCP server, so rebar.comment() returns normally with no push failure signal to the caller
MCP write tools return only server-side result strings; the tool result is never read from server stderr by the agent, making push rejections invisible despite install_stderr_handler firing
Reconciler subprocess logs under 'rebar' root but installs handler on 'rebar_reconciler', creating a mute push path even in foreground
A durable marker file in the git dir plus push_status field on MCP write-tool outputs surfaces failed push state to all paths without changing exit codes or raising exceptions
